description: This line plot compares the Macro-F1 Score (%) for two methods—“MATTER (ours)” and “w/o material information”—as a function of the Number of tokens, which is plotted on the x-axis using a linear scale ranging from 0.6 to 1.4 with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis represents the Macro-F1 Score (%) on a linear scale, ranging from 48% to 56%. The “MATTER (ours)” method is depicted by a red line with circular markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 55.2% at 0.6 tokens, peaking at 57.2% at 1.0 tokens, and ending at approximately 50.8% at 1.4 tokens. The “w/o material information” method is shown by a purple line with circular markers and a dashed line style, beginning at approximately 52.2% at 0.6 tokens, remaining relatively flat around 52.2–53.8% until 1.2 tokens, then sharply declining to 48.0% at 1.4 tokens. Both lines are accompanied by shaded regions indicating uncertainty or confidence intervals, with the red line’s region being light pink and the purple line’s region being light gray.
